<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.EVGCMS_ScopeHelpUtil</api_name><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Global Scope helper script supporting the ESS Portal and Catalog Application

Version 3.0</description><name>EVGCMS_ScopeHelpUtil</name><script><![CDATA[var EVGCMS_ScopeHelpUtil = Class.create();
EVGCMS_ScopeHelpUtil.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },
	
	canViewCatalogItem : function( catItemID ) {
		var catItem = GlideappCatalogItem.get(catItemID);
		if ( !catItem.canView() ) {
			return false;
		}
		
		return true;
	},
	
	canViewCategory : function( categoryID ) {
		var category = GlideappCategory.get(categoryID);
		if ( category.canView() ) {	
			return true;	
		}
		
		return false;
	},
	
	canReadArticle: function(kb) {
		var knowledgeHelper = new SNC.KnowledgeHelper(); 
		if (kb.getTableName() == "kb_knowledge" || kb.getTableName() == "kb_knowledge_base") {
			if ( knowledgeHelper.canRead(kb) ) {
				var kbHelper = new KnowledgeHelp(kb);
				return kbHelper.hasRights(kb);
			}
        }

		return false;
	},
	
	getRequestItemVariables : function( requestID ) {
		var aReturnList = [];
		try {
			var set = new GlideappVariablePoolQuestionSet();
			set.setRequestID(requestID);
			set.load();
		
			var vs = set.getFlatQuestions();
			var iNumberOfVars = vs.size();		
			for (var i = 0; i < iNumberOfVars; i++) {
				var newVar = {};
				var currentVar = vs.get(i);
				newVar.name = currentVar.getName().toString();
				newVar.label = newVar.name;
				newVar.displayValue = "";
				if ( typeof currentVar.getLabel == "function" ) {			
					var sTmpLabel = currentVar.getLabel();
					if ( sTmpLabel != null ) {
						newVar.label = sTmpLabel.toString();
					}
				}
				
				if ( typeof currentVar.getDisplayValue == "function" ) {			
					var sTmpValue = currentVar.getDisplayValue();
					if ( sTmpValue != null ) {
						newVar.displayValue = sTmpValue.toString();
					}
				}
				aReturnList.push(newVar);
			}
		} catch (err ) {
			gs.error('[EVGCMS_ScopeHelpUtil.getRequestItemVariables] Error: ' + err);	
		}
		
		return aReturnList;
	},
	
	setPreference : function(sPrefName, sPrefValue) {
		gs.getUser().setPreference(sPrefName, sPrefValue);
	},
	
	getLiveFeedProfile : function( sUserID ) {
		if ( sUserID == null ) { sUserID = gs.getUserID(); }
		var util = new LiveFeedUtil();
		var tmpProfileID = util.getUserProfile(sUserID);
		
		return new String(tmpProfileID);
	},
	
	getAllJournalEntries : function( fRecord ) {
		return fRecord.comments.getJournalEntry(-1);
	},
	
	getUserTimeZone : function() {
		var tz = gs.getSession().getTimeZone();
		return tz;
	},
	
	setTZ : function( dDate, tz ) {
		if ( typeof dDate != "undefined" ) {
			dDate.setTZ(tz);
		}
		
		return dDate;
	},
	
	saveRecord : function( fRecord ) {
		return fRecord.update();
	},
	
	refreshNavigator : function() {
		var notification = new UINotification('system_event');
		notification.setAttribute('event', 'refresh_nav');
		notification.send();
	},
	
	isCMS : function() {
		return GlideTransaction.get().isVirtual();
	},
	
	eventQueueScheduled : function(sEventReg, fTargetRec, sUserID, sUserName, dDateTime) {
		gs.eventQueueScheduled(sEventReg, fTargetRec, sUserID, sUserName, dDateTime);
	},
	
	getSessionToken : function() {
		return gs.getSessionToken();
	},
	
	getWorkflowStageObj : function( fRecord, stageField ) {
		var workflowStageObj = {};
		try {
			var stageChoiceList = this.getWorkflowStages(fRecord, stageField);
			var processedChoiceList = this.getWorkflowIcons("fRecord.stage", fRecord[stageField], fRecord).process(stageChoiceList);
			workflowStageObj = this.convertToWorkflowStageObj(processedChoiceList);
		} catch (err) {
		}
		
		return workflowStageObj;
	},
	
	getWorkflowStages : function( fRecord, stageField ) {
		var evg_answer = new GlideChoiceList();
		var version = null;
		var contextID = null;
		try {
			if (fRecord.context) {
				// We have already started a workflow for the item, use its version
				version = fRecord.context.workflow_version;
				contextID = fRecord.context.sys_id.toString();
			} else {
				// We have not started a workflow for the item yet (pending request approval) so
				// determine the version we will eventually be using
				if ( fRecord.cat_item != undefined ) {
					if ( !fRecord.cat_item.workflow.nil() ) {
						version = new Workflow().getVersion(fRecord.cat_item.workflow).sys_id + '';
					} else {
						evg_answer.add("waiting_for_approval", gs.getMessage("Waiting for Approval")); // always add this
						var planID = GlideappDeliveryPlan.resolvePlanID(fRecord);
						var plan = GlideAbstractExecutionPlan.get(planID);
						if (plan != null) {
							var tokens = plan.getSortedTokenList();
							for (var xxx = 0; xxx < tokens.size(); xxx++) {
								var tt = tokens.get(xxx);
								evg_answer.add(tt.getName(), gs.getMessage(tt.getName()));
							}
						}
   
						evg_answer.add("closed_incomplete", gs.getMessage("Closed Incomplete"));
						evg_answer.add("Request Cancelled", gs.getMessage("Request Cancelled"));
						evg_answer.add("complete", gs.getMessage("Completed"));	
					}
				} else {
					var contextRec = new Workflow().getContexts(fRecord);
					if (contextRec.next()) {
						version = contextRec.workflow_version;
						contextID = contextRec.sys_id.toString();
					} else {
						var clg = new GlideChoiceListGenerator(fRecord.getTableName(), stageField);
						clg.setCache(false);
						clg.setNone(false);
						clg.get(answer);
						var iSelected = 0;
						for ( var q=0; q<evg_answer.getSize(); q++ ) {
							var choiceItem = evg_answer.getChoice(q);
							if ( choiceItem.value == fRecord[stageField] ) {
								choiceItem.setSelected(true);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		
			if ( version != null && version != "") {
				var fScriptRec = new GlideRecord('sys_script');
				fScriptRec.script = "var wfs = new WorkflowStages();wfs.setWorkflowVersion(version, contextID);wfs.getChoices(current[stageField], answer);";
			
				var evaluator = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
				var vars = {'current' : fRecord, 'version': version, 'contextID':contextID, 'stageField':stageField, 'answer':evg_answer};
				evaluator.evaluateScript(fScriptRec, 'script', vars);
				evg_answer = evaluator.getVariable('answer');

				if ( evg_answer.getSize() == 0 ) {
					var fScriptRec2 = new GlideRecord('sys_script');
					fScriptRec2.script = "var wfs = new WorkflowStages();wfs.getSimpleChoiceList(current.getTableName(), stageField, answer);";
					var evaluator2 = new GlideScopedEvaluator();
					var vars2 = {'current' : fRecord, 'stageField':stageField, 'answer':evg_answer};
					evaluator2.evaluateScript(fScriptRec2, 'script', vars2);
					evg_answer = evaluator2.getVariable('answer');
				}
			}		
		} catch( err) {
		}
				
		return evg_answer;
	},
	
	getWorkflowIcons : function( elementName, element, fRecord ) {
		return new EVGCMS_ScopeWorkflowIcons(elementName, element, fRecord);
	},
	
	convertToWorkflowStageObj : function( cl ) {
		var returnObj = [];
		try {
			for (var i = 0; i < cl.size(); i++) {
				var c = cl.getChoice(i);
				var choiceItem = {};
				choiceItem.value = c.getValue();
				choiceItem.label = c.getLabel();
				choiceItem.image = c.image;
				choiceItem.icon = this.getWorkflowIcon(choiceItem.image);
				returnObj.push(choiceItem);
			}
		} catch (err) {
		}
      
		return returnObj;
	},
	
	getWorkflowIcon : function( sImage ) {
		var sImageKey = "evgcms_stageimage::"+sImage;
		var sReturnIcon = gs.getMessage(sImageKey);
		if ( sImageKey != sReturnIcon ) {
			return sReturnIcon;	
		}
		
		return "fa-circle blue";
	},
	
	templateOrMacroExists : function( sTemplateName ) {
		return gs.templateOrMacroExists( sTemplateName );
	},
	
	getMyRoles : function() {
		return gs.getSession().getRoles();
	},
	
	addItemToCart : function( cartName, catItemID, quantity, vars) {
		var cart = new EVGCMS_CartUtil(cartName, gs.getUserID());
		var cartItemID = cart.addItem(catItemID, quantity);
		for ( var key in vars ) {
			cart.setVariable(cartItemID, key, vars[key]);
		}
		
		return cartItemID;
	},
	
	removeItemFromCart : function( id) {
		var c = new GlideappCart();
		c.remove(id);
	},
	
	placeOrder : function( request, response ) {
		var c =  new GlideappCart();
		c.addToCart(request);
		return new CatalogTransactionCheckout(request, response).execute(); 
	},
	
	updateCart : function( request, cartItem ) {
		var cartName = request.getParameter("sysparm_cart_name");
		var c = new GlideappCart(cartName);
		c.updateCart(request, cartItem);
	},
	
	getCartItemPrice : function( fCartItemRec, bRecurring ) {
		if ( bRecurring == null ) { bRecurring = false; }
		var calculator;
		if ( bRecurring ) {
			calculator = new CatalogRecurringPriceCalculator(fCartItemRec);
		} else {
			calculator = new CatalogPriceCalculator(fCartItemRec);
		}
		return calculator.calcPrice();
	},
	
	getCartItemVariables : function( fCartItemRec ) {
		var aReturnData = [];
		var theLabels = new CatalogLabelEvaluator(fCartItemRec).getLabels();
		for ( var i=0; i<theLabels.length; i++ ) {
			var tmpVarObj = {};
			tmpVarObj.question_label = theLabels[i][0];
			tmpVarObj.display_value = theLabels[i][1];
			tmpVarObj.macro = theLabels[i][2];
			tmpVarObj.question_id = theLabels[i][3];
			aReturnData.push(tmpVarObj);
		}
		
		return aReturnData;
	},
	
	getCatalogItemIDs_ForCategory : function( sCategoryID, sSCItemClass ) {
		var itemList = [];
		try {
			var category = GlideappCategory.get(sCategoryID);
			var tmpItems = category.getItemsNoDuplicates().toArray();
			for ( var x=0;x<tmpItems.length; x++) {
				if ( tmpItems[x].canView() ) {
					itemList.push(tmpItems[x].getID());
				}
			}
		} catch( err) {
			gs.error('[EVGCMS_ScopeHelpUtil.getCatalogItemIDs_ForCategory] ERROR: '+ err);	
		}
			
		return itemList;
	},
	
	deleteRecord : function( fRecord ) {
		return fRecord.deleteRecord();
	},
	
	insertRecord : function( fRecord ) {
		return fRecord.insert();
	},
	
	incrementViewCount : function( fRecord ) {
		fRecord.incrementViewCount();
	},
	
	spLogStat : function (spEngine, sView, sTable, sID, sLabel) {
		spEngine(sView, sTable, sID, sLabel);
	},
	
	isDateType : function(element) {
		return element.getED().isDateType();
	},
	
	writeJournalUpdate : function( fRecord, inputField, inputValue) {
		fRecord.setDisplayValue(inputField, inputValue);
		if ( fRecord.update() ) {
			return true;
		}
		
		return false;
	},
	
	getStageLabels : function( fRecord) {
		try {
			var cl = new GlideChoiceList();
			GlideController.putGlobal("answer", cl);
			GlideController.putGlobal("current", fRecord);
			sc_req_item_stageGetChoices();
			return JSON.parse(cl.toJSON());
		} catch (err) {
			gs.error('[getStageLabels] Error:'+err);
			return [];
		}
	},
	
	choieListToJSON : function(cl) {
		try {
			var returnJSON = [];
			for (var i = 0; i < cl.size(); i++) {
				var c = cl.getChoice(i);
				var choiceItem = {};
				choiceItem.value = c.getValue();
				choiceItem.label = c.getLabel();
				returnJSON.push(choiceItem);
			}
			
			return returnJSON;
		} catch(err) {
			gs.error('[EVGCMS_ScopeHelpUtil.choieListToJSON] Error:'+err);
			return [];
		}
	},
	
	getCurrencyCode : function() {
		var locale = GlideLocale.get();
		return locale.getCurrencyCode();
	},
	
	calculateSLA : function( fTaskSLA, bCalc, dEndTime) {
		SLACalculatorNG.calculateSLA(fTaskSLA, bCalc, dEndTime);
	},

    type: 'EVGCMS_ScopeHelpUtil'
};

/**
 * This is only used to handle Request Items with a Delivery Plan or a Workflow.
 */
gs.include("PrototypeServer");

var EVGCMS_ScopeWorkflowIcons = Class.create();
EVGCMS_ScopeWorkflowIcons.prototype = Object.extendsObject(WorkflowIconsStages, { 
	initialize: function(elementName, element, fRecord) {
		this.elementName = elementName;
		this.element = element;      
		this.gr = fRecord;
		if (!this.gr.cat_item.workflow || this.gr.cat_item.workflow.nil()) {
			this.handler = new GlideappRequestItemWorkflow(this.gr);
		} else {
			this.handler = null;
		}
	},
   
	process: function(c) {
		if (this.handler) {
			return this.handler.generateChoices(c);
		}
		
		if ( c != null && c != "undefined" ) {
			for (var i = 0; i < c.getSize(); i++) {
				var choiceItem = c.getChoice(i);
			}
		}

		return WorkflowIconsStages.prototype.process.call(this, c);
	},
 
   type: "EVGCMS_ScopeWorkflowIcons"
});

var EVGCMS_CartUtil = Class.create();
EVGCMS_CartUtil.prototype = {
    initialize: function(cartName, userID) {
        this.cartName = !cartName ? null : cartName;
        this.userID = !userID ? null : userID;

        this.cart = this.getCart();
    },

    getCart: function() {
        var cart = GlideappCart.getCartForRhino(this.cartName, this.userID);
        return cart.getGlideRecord();
    },

    clearCart: function() {
        var id = this.cart.sys_id;
        var kids = new GlideRecord('sc_cart_item');
        kids.addQuery('cart', id);
        kids.deleteMultiple();
    },
    
    deleteCart: function() {
        var cart = GlideappCart.getCartForRhino(this.cartName, this.userID);
        cart.empty();
    },

    addItem: function(itemID, quantity) {
        if (typeof (quantity) == 'undefined')
            quantity = 1;
        var gr = new GlideRecord('sc_cart_item');
        gr.initialize();
        gr.cart = this.cart.sys_id;
        gr.cat_item = itemID;
        gr.quantity = quantity;
        var rc = gr.insert();
        this.prepVariables(itemID, rc);
        return rc;
    },

    prepVariables: function(itemID, cart_id) {
        var ci = GlideappCatalogItem.get(itemID);
        var gr = ci.getStandaloneVariables();
		var seq = ci.getKeySequence();
        while (gr.next()) {
            var question = new GlideappQuestion(gr.sys_id);
            var variable = new GlideRecord('sc_item_option');
            variable.initialize();
            variable.value.setValue(question.getValue());
            variable.item_option_new = gr.sys_id;
            variable.cart_item = cart_id;
			for (var i = 0; i < seq.size(); i++) {
				if (seq.get(i) + "" == gr.sys_id + "")
		            variable.order = i + "";
			}
            variable.insert();
        }
    },

    setVariable: function(cartID, variable_name, value) {
        var variable = new GlideRecord('sc_item_option');
        variable.addQuery('cart_item', cartID);
        variable.addQuery('item_option_new', variable_name).addOrCondition('item_option_new.name', variable_name);
        variable.query();
        if (variable.next()) {
			variable.value.setValue(value);
            variable.update();
        }
    },

    placeOrder: function() {
        var req = new GlideappRequestNew();
        var rc = req.copyCart(this.cartName, this.userID);
        this.clearCart();
        return rc;
    },
	
	type: "EVGCMS_CartUtil"
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jbenedict</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2015-03-06 22:24:51</sys_created_on><sys_customer_update>true</sys_customer_update><sys_id>3f345ec74f6e3100b530b82ca310c771</sys_id><sys_mod_count>128</sys_mod_count><sys_name>EVGCMS_ScopeHelpUtil</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace_on_upgrade>false</sys_replace_on_upgrade><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_3f345ec74f6e3100b530b82ca310c771</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>jbenedict</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2016-07-18 22:25:54</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
